Desc.SourceString: 我不喜欢争斗，但如果和其他人发生争斗，我会赢！
Desc.LocalizedString: I don't like fighting, but if you insist, I'll destroy you.

Desc.SourceString: 眼中无枪，心中有枪。
Desc.LocalizedString: Do not aim with your eyes. Aim with your heart.

Desc.SourceString: 卡丘人每次濒死时都会变得更强大……开玩笑的，没这种事。
Desc.LocalizedString: They say whatever doesn't kill you makes you stronger. Hah! It doesn't.

Desc.SourceString: 还有王法吗！还有法律吗！
Desc.LocalizedString: Is there no justice? No law?

Desc.SourceString: 横冲直撞，无人能挡！
Desc.LocalizedString: I am Death, the destroyer of worlds!

Desc.SourceString: 我走过了，你们倒下了。
Desc.LocalizedString: I've passed through, and you've fallen.

Desc.SourceString: 胜利是对坚守者最好的奖赏。
Desc.LocalizedString: Victory is the best reward for those who persevere.

Desc.SourceString: 运气，也是实力的一部分。
Desc.LocalizedString: Luck is part of skill too.

Desc.SourceString: 不客气，这是我应该做的。你帮我，我帮你，我们把把在一起~
Desc.LocalizedString: You're welcome. It's what I'm here for. You'll help me, I'll help you. We're in this together!

Desc.SourceString: 你们五个一起上，我在赶时间。
Desc.LocalizedString: Come at me, I've got no time to spare.

Desc.SourceString: 打了我还想跑？
Desc.LocalizedString: Think you can run?

Desc.SourceString: 你给我下来！
Desc.LocalizedString: Get down here!

Desc.SourceString: 弦化虽好，但我技高一筹~
Desc.LocalizedString: Stringification is impressive, but I'm simply superior!

Desc.SourceString: 仿照黑猫先生自画像制作，带有白墨签名的定制徽章——用以纪念那场特别的“黑猫行动”。
Desc.LocalizedString: A custom badge modeled after Mr. Black Cat's self-portrait, with a white ink signature—commemorating the special "Black Cat Operation."

Desc.SourceString: 所有人目光的中心、派对的焦点——就是你啦！生日快乐哦！
Desc.LocalizedString: You're the center of everyone's attention, the life of the party—happy birthday!

Desc.SourceString: 我能感觉到你对他们深深的爱。
Desc.LocalizedString: I feel your deep love for them.

Desc.SourceString: 真正浪漫主义的人可以拿枪来当乐器！
Desc.LocalizedString: A true romantic can use a gun as a musical instrument!

Desc.SourceString: 纪念那些喜欢射击游戏的玩家。
Desc.LocalizedString: For players who love shooting games.

Desc.SourceString: 挑战极限，成就自我无限光辉。
Desc.LocalizedString: Challenge your limits and seize ultimate glory.

Desc.SourceString: 引航者，未来就在你的手中。
Desc.LocalizedString: The future is in your hands, Navigator.

Desc.SourceString: 如同太阳一般，冉冉升起的新星。
Desc.LocalizedString: A rising star as bright as the sun.

Desc.SourceString:
KQ0100年，面对崩溃症带来的巨大隐患，欧泊启动百年轮回计划。
由此，世界陷入矛盾与悲剧的螺旋。
Desc.LocalizedString: In the year KQ0100, to counter the devastating threat of Collapse Syndrome, P.U.S. launched the Hundred-Year Restoration Initiative. This thrust the world into a spiral of conflict and tragedy.

Desc.SourceString: 乌尔比诺财团欢迎您的加入！
Desc.LocalizedString: Welcome to Urbino Business Alliance!

Desc.SourceString: 那些用灵魂铸造徽记的人，永远也不可能向命运屈服。因为他们代表的是最硬派的勇士，‌淬炼出了钢铁般的意志。
Desc.LocalizedString: Those who forge with their soul refuse to surrender to fate, representing the mightiest warriors with steel-like resolve.

Desc.SourceString: 我们汇集成点。
Desc.LocalizedString: We gather as one.

Desc.SourceString: 我们彼此连结.
Desc.LocalizedString: We are united.

Desc.SourceString: 我们无所不在。
Desc.LocalizedString: We are omnipresent.

Desc.SourceString: 我们跨越一切！
Desc.LocalizedString: We transcend all!

Desc.SourceString: 乌尔比诺，支持每一个人去追求独属于自己的那份艺术感。
Desc.LocalizedString: Urbino encourages everyone to pursue their unique sense of artistry.

Desc.SourceString: “守信之心”是颁发给讲信誉、守信用之人的最高奖励。遇到佩戴“守信之心”的小伙伴，请不要吝惜自己的夸赞哦~
Desc.LocalizedString: The Heart of Integrity is the highest award given to individuals who demonstrate honesty and reliability. If you meet someone wearing it, don't hesitate to shower them with praise!

Desc.SourceString: 你对瓶中之物的每一次提炼，都有可能诞生惊喜。
Desc.LocalizedString: Each time you distill the contents of the bottle, a surprise may emerge.

Desc.SourceString: 据说戴上它，就能被菠萝包的温暖甜蜜直击心灵！……不、不许笑，伙伴，你也一起来试试！
Desc.LocalizedString: It is said that wearing it warms your heart with the sweetness of pineapple buns... Hey, don't laugh! You, try it on!

Desc.SourceString: 前辈，星与星之间也是有牵绊与联结的，构成“双星”的两颗恒星将绕着共同的中心点长久环绕，互不分离……
Desc.LocalizedString: There are connections and bonds among stars. Two stars that make up the binary system will revolve around a center of mass in eternity. They will never be apart...

Desc.SourceString: 经过了命运的淬炼，这副躯壳中的灵魂闪耀着坚毅的光芒。
Desc.LocalizedString: Forged by fate, this soul shines with resilience.

Desc.SourceString: 在“晶源感染”危机爆发期，普雷顿曾被大量粉尘覆盖。危机结束后，近郊区域散落了部分被析出的晶石粉末。工作人员对其进行收集分析，以避免相似的灾难再度发生。
Desc.LocalizedString: During the peak of the Outbreak incident, Preton was blanketed with dust. After the crisis ended, crystallized powder was found scattered in the suburban areas. Researchers collected and analyzed these samples to help prevent similar disasters from occurring again.

Desc.SourceString: 让我把这个发饰给您……？您想体验一下成为女仆的感觉？
Desc.LocalizedString: You want the headdress...? Are you trying to experience what it's like to be a maid?

Desc.SourceString: 心夏探险的认证收藏品。
Desc.LocalizedString: Certified collectibles from Kokona's adventures.

Desc.SourceString: 多次探险后的认证收藏品，颁给我们的寻宝专家。
Desc.LocalizedString: Certified collectible awarded to our treasure-hunting expert after numerous expeditions.

Desc.SourceString: 艺术之城的新星正在冉冉升起。
Desc.LocalizedString: A rising star in the City of Art.
